post.message: Reminder: Q2 RCSA refresh is due next Friday. If you have any open control owner attestations, please update the status and attach supporting evidence (screen grabs or ticket IDs) so we’re audit-ready.

Workplace Services note for the issues log: we completed the annual fire extinguisher inspection across HQ. Certificates are in the vendor portal; if you need a copy for the exam binder, I can upload PDFs to the shared evidence folder.

Heads up: the lobby flooring contractor is proposing the weekend of 4/20 for the polish/seal work. Minimal access impact, but we’ll need to rope off the east entrance for ~6 hours. Maria—OK to proceed if Procurement clears the COI?
Yes, proceed once COI + W-9 are on file and the SOW includes after-hours cleanup. Kevin, please also confirm they’ll follow our vendor badge process (check-in at Security, no tailgating).

Separate item: we had 2 instances this week of locked-file shred bins being overfilled in the branch ops area. Not a breach, but it’s a process gap. Maria/Kevin—can Workplace Services coordinate with the shredding vendor on pickup frequency?

I’ll reach out to IronClad Shred today to move us from biweekly to weekly pickups for the next 60 days, then we can reassess. Daniel—do you want a quick comms note to staff about not forcing materials into full bins?

On the upcoming regulatory exam logistics: we can reserve the large conference room for the examiner workroom and ensure guest Wi-Fi instructions are printed. Daniel, send me the date range and expected headcount so we can set up access badges in advance.

Thanks—dates are 5/6 through 5/17, likely 4 examiners onsite. I’ll share the examiner list once Compliance finalizes. Also, please confirm the after-hours cleaning schedule for that room so we can include it in the exam readiness checklist.

Logging recurring employee complaints about inconsistent temperatures on HQ 4th floor (east side pods + two conference rooms). Not a control failure, but it’s impacting service levels (call time + meeting relocations). @maria.santos can Facilities confirm root cause + what action was taken so we can close the issue entry with remediation details?

Yes — this was a routine facilities maintenance issue (no compliance/investigation component). We found two thermostats in the 4th-floor HVAC zone intermittently failing/reading high, which was causing the zone to overcorrect. Action taken: Facilities replaced both failing thermostats and we rescheduled the preventive-maintenance cycle for the 4th-floor zone (moved it up to a monthly check for the next quarter). Complaints have dropped since the replacement.

FYI for visibility: HVAC temp complaints (HQ 4th floor) - vendor confirmed Thermostat #4F-17 and #4F-19 were failing intermittently. Both units replaced this morning; calibrated and tested across the zone. We also adjusted PM schedule for the 4th-floor zone per Maria’s direction (monthly spot-checks through end of quarter, then revert to standard cycle if stable).

Thanks Kevin. Please keep the work order notes + vendor service report attached in the ticket; if anyone asks, the remediation is simply thermostat replacements + accelerated PM cycle for that specific 4th-floor HVAC zone. Nothing regulatory here—just building ops stabilization.
Perfect—closing the issue log entry with: replaced two failing thermostats and rescheduled the preventive-maintenance cycle for the 4th-floor HVAC zone. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
